business_problem: This multivendor approach led to inconsistency and posed challenges for new development projects because of lengthy process and acquisition times.
solution_summary: Manulife modernized its analytics estate on Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure SQL Managed Instance, Azure Machine Learning, moving from fragmented legacy tooling to a governed cloud data platform. Operational, enterprise, or sensor data is ingested into a shared cloud store and transformed with Azure engineering services so teams can work from one current source of truth. To this end, Manulife is reimagining the insurance and financial services industry, and it's doing that with Microsoft Azure "Our development time is 30 percent lower now, and our cost savings are in the 50 percent range with our Azure Kubernetes Service environment." solution_components.name: Azure Kubernetes Service
solution_components.role: Hosts scalable APIs, microservices, and model-serving workloads in containers.

solution_components.name: Azure SQL Managed Instance
solution_components.role: Provides managed relational storage for modernized line-of-business applications.

solution_components.name: Azure Machine Learning
solution_components.role: Supports model development, experimentation, and deployment for predictive workloads.

solution_components.name: Azure Databricks
solution_components.role: Transforms large-scale data and runs analytical or machine-learning workloads.

solution_components.name: Azure Synapse Analytics
solution_components.role: Runs integrated SQL and big-data analytics across enterprise datasets.

data_flow: Data flows from operational systems through source-system connectors into the platform data layer, where Azure Databricks prepares and enriches it; business applications then exposes governed analytics and decision support to end users.
